subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Dating Pregnancy: Naegele Rule, CRL and Booking Visit

steps.tx: Estimating delivery date by adding a year, subtracting three months and adding seven days to the last period is the **Naegele rule**. It assumes a twenty eight day cycle with ovulation on day fourteen. Longer cycles need corresponding adjustment. For a 35 day cycle the rule overestimates by a week, so seven days are added to the calculated date.
steps.say: The Naegele rule adds a year, subtracts three months and adds seven days to the last period.

steps.tx: The most accurate ultrasound dating measurement in the first trimester is **crown-rump length**. Between seven and thirteen weeks it dates pregnancy within about five days. Later measurements become progressively less precise for dating. Head circumference takes over for dating between 14 and 20 weeks when the crown rump window was missed.
steps.say: Crown-rump length dates pregnancy within five days between seven and thirteen weeks.

steps.tx: The fluid filled structure first visible in the uterus on transvaginal scan is the **gestational sac**. It appears at about four and a half to five weeks. The yolk sac follows, then the embryo with cardiac activity. The double decidual sign, two concentric rings around the sac, marks a true early intrauterine sac on scan.
steps.say: The gestational sac appears first, followed by yolk sac then embryo with cardiac activity.

steps.tx: Booking sets dates. Adding seven days and nine months to the last menstrual period is the Naegele estimate, but crown-rump length from seven to thirteen weeks replaces it when they differ. Transvaginal scan shows a **gestational sac** by five weeks, from four and a half, then the yolk sac and cardiac activity. The double decidual sign is two rings around a true intrauterine sac. Haemoglobin, blood group, and syphilis serology are drawn.
steps.say: Booking sets dates. Adding seven days and nine months to the last menstrual period is the Naegele estimate, but crown-rump length from seven to thirteen weeks replaces it when they differ. Transvaginal scan shows a gestational sac by five weeks, from four and a half, then the yolk sac and cardiac activity. The double decidual sign is two rings around a true intrauterine sac. Haemoglobin, blood group, and syphilis serology are drawn.

vis.caption: Booking brings together menstrual dating, crown-rump length, the early gestational sac, and the first blood tests. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: The first comprehensive antenatal appointment assessing risks and baselines is the **booking visit**. Blood group, haemoglobin, infections and blood pressure are recorded. A care plan and visit schedule follow from this assessment. Booking by 12 weeks lets dating, screening for Down syndrome and anaemia checks all happen on time.
steps.say: The booking visit records baselines and builds the antenatal care plan.

steps.tx: Routine contacts through pregnancy for a first baby number about ten, scheduled as **antenatal visits**. Blood pressure and urine are checked at every visit, with growth assessment from mid pregnancy. Additional visits follow any complication. For women with complications the schedule compresses, with visits every two weeks after 28 weeks and weekly near term.
steps.say: Antenatal visits check pressure and urine each time, with growth assessment from mid pregnancy.

steps.tx: When menstrual dating and early scan disagree by more than a week, the scan wins, a rule of **scan dating precedence**. The estimated date is then fixed and not changed by later scans. This prevents post term misclassification. Changing the date later from a growth scan wrongly labels normal babies as growth restricted, which is why the date is locked.
steps.say: Scan dating takes precedence when it disagrees with menstrual dates by over a week.

steps.tx: Booking **infectious screening** tests every pregnant woman for syphilis, hepatitis B and HIV, whether or not any risk is declared. Each infection can cross to the baby silently, and each has treatment that sharply cuts that transmission when started early. A positive HIV result begins antiretroviral therapy within days. Rubella immunity is checked alongside, not for treatment now, but to plan vaccination after delivery.
steps.say: Booking infectious screening prevents mother to child transmission through early treatment. Syphilis, hepatitis B and HIV are tested at the booking visit.

vis.alt: Booking blood screening panel listing syphilis, hepatitis B and HIV tests with early treatment arrows protecting the baby from mother to child transmission.
vis.caption: Three infections are hunted in every booking sample because treating the mother early prevents most transmission to her baby. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Screening bloods at booking include syphilis, hepatitis B and HIV under **infectious screening**. Early treatment prevents most mother to child transmission. Rubella immunity is also checked to advise postpartum vaccination. A positive HIV result triggers antiretroviral treatment the same week, cutting transmission to under one percent.
steps.say: Booking infectious screening prevents mother to child transmission through early treatment.

steps.tx: Risk assessment at booking assigns women to midwifery or consultant led care pathways, termed **care stratification**. Previous caesarean, hypertension and diabetes mandate consultant involvement. Low risk women need fewer interventions with equally good outcomes. Body mass index over 35, age over 40 and previous stillbirth each move a woman out of the low risk pathway.
steps.say: Care stratification assigns consultant led care for previous caesarean, hypertension and diabetes.

steps.tx: Documentation of the dating and plan in handheld notes ensures **continuity of care**. Every provider sees the same estimated date and risk summary. This prevents contradictory advice and duplicated testing. Handheld notes also carry the blood group, so an emergency team can order group specific blood without repeating the test.
steps.say: Handheld notes ensure every provider sees the same date and risk summary.
